scope: La Laguna judge/magistrate and LAJ identity closure for DP 748/2026, Cambiario 1048/2019, ETJ 163/2020, PO 344/2013 and TF-APP-004, with Arrecife/Yaiza judicial-cooperation actors kept separate.

gaps.question: Who signed the 24-Mar-2026 Auto 454/2026 provisionally dismissing/archiving DP 748/2026?
verified_minimum: Current primary-source controls verify the existence, date, number and provisional-dismissal effect of Auto 454/2026.
The 17-Apr-2026 reform and subsidiary appeal is source-verified as directed against that Auto.
The 20-May-2026 Providencia records the reform and subsidiary appeal as interposed in time and form.
gaps.not_proved: The signed/authenticated original identifying the judicial signatory of the 24-Mar act remains unlocated in the controlled corpus. Graciela Pérez-Valencia Díaz is not attributed to that act merely because she signs later DP 748/2026 acts.
gaps.closure_trigger: Signed or authenticated electronic original of Auto 454/2026, or equivalent primary court source expressly identifying its judicial signatory.

gaps.question: Which LAJ(s) signed or were identified on the material procedural acts in PO 344/2013?
verified_minimum: Sentencia 41/2014 identifies María Mercedes Santana Rodríguez as the deciding judge.
The judgment records a 21-May-2013 decree admitting the claim and a 27-Jun-2013 diligencia de ordenación convening the preliminary hearing.
gaps.not_proved: The presently recovered source does not name the LAJ for those acts or establish a proceeding-wide LAJ identity.
gaps.closure_trigger: Certified/primary signed 21-May-2013 decree, 27-Jun-2013 diligencia, authenticated docket, or another primary PO 344/2013 act naming the relevant LAJ for the act and period.

gaps.question: What is the verified downstream appellate processing, organ, roll and any judicial/LAJ office-holder identity?
verified_minimum: The 17-Apr-2026 filing expressly contains a subsidiary appeal.
The 20-May-2026 Providencia records the reform and subsidiary appeal as interposed in time and form at the origin court.
The 16-Jul-2026 order is non-final and records an appeal instruction; its 1-Sep-2026 notification lane is source-controlled.
gaps.not_proved: No primary Article 766.4 transfer, remittal/transmission to the Audiencia, appellate roll or equivalent appellate source has been located in the current controlled corpus. No Audiencia organ, panel, judge or LAJ is therefore populated.
gaps.closure_trigger: Primary court or Audiencia source identifying transfer/remittal/transmission, appellate roll or equivalent downstream processing and, separately, any named appellate judge/panel/LAJ.

source_search_boundary: A finite search pass is not proof that a missing source does not exist. Promotion requires a primary source sufficient to identify the person, organ and exact act/capacity relied upon.
liability_boundary: Identity registration and gap status establish source linkage only. They do not establish wrongdoing, intent, liability, agreement with a party or merits treatment.
